enrichment.summary: North Bay Soccer Referee Association would provide officials for all scheduled middle and high school soccer games and continue a program for certifying officials. enrichment.summary: An Oakland individual would teach English to non-native-speaking parents at Elmhurst United Middle School, focusing on communicating with school staff and supporting their children's success. enrichment.headline: Pays Space80seven up to $5,001 for a music-industry career showcase at Fremont High School
enrichment.summary: Space80seven LLC would produce a 60-minute assembly for each grade (10 to 12) at Fremont High School, featuring live performances by two local artists and a magazine release, to showcase students' career-exploration internship work. The agreement started December 1, 2022, before this vote, and runs through January 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Space80seven up to $41,000 for a music-industry internship for nine Fremont High students
enrichment.summary: Space80seven LLC would run a hands-on, pre-apprenticeship style internship for nine students in Fremont High School's media and architecture career and technical education programs. outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
